rca_of_issue: Reported issue: 'packager is not running'. Root cause was stale Metro/Expo cache after the SDK 54→57 upgrade combined with subsequent app.json changes (added expo.updates.enabled=false, expo.runtimeVersion.policy=appVersion). The stale cache still referenced SDK-54 module resolutions and pre-updates.enabled config, causing the on-device Expo Go client to mismatch the served manifest. Fix (already applied by main agent): (a) sudo supervisorctl stop expo, (b) rm -rf frontend/.metro-cache frontend/.expo frontend/node_modules/.cache, (c) sudo supervisorctl start expo. Verification (this iteration): Metro now bundles cleanly (1512 modules per main agent), supervisor uptime confirmed at pid 22795, both iOS and Android manifest endpoints return valid JSON with runtimeVersion=1.0.0 and correct launchAsset.url, web preview is 200-healthy, and no cache-leftover keywords (expo-updates/runtimeVersion/module-resolution errors) appear in the browser console after full app traversal. Mitigation is complete from the app side. Next preventive action: after any SDK bump or app.json edit that touches updates/runtimeVersion, immediately clear .metro-cache + .expo + node_modules/.cache and restart the expo supervisor before asking the user to reload Expo Go.
